text:
maria: Heads-up — we had another customer ping about billing/attribution confusion. Console says request used org key XYZ but metrics show project P123 consumed the quota. Customer wants a clear "why was I billed" path.
raj: ugh. is this the exchange + proxy pathing again? older proxies strip origin headers so we lose the original_chaining info.
kevin: can you paste an example log line? maybe we can trace in traces.
maria: here's a redacted request from their trace:
```
INFO auth=allow key_id=org_XYZ route=service-a -> service-b final_project=P123 origin_header="-"
```
maria: note origin_header is missing.
raj: that's the problem. We currently rely on `x-origin-key-id` injected at ingress, but our edge LB sometimes normalizes headers. we should sign the origin info into a JWT and send as `x-origin-jwt` so downstream can verify and preserve chain.
kevin: signing sounds good, but we need to decide payload shape. my suggestion:
```
{ "origin_key": "org_XYZ", "actor": "service-account:svc-1", "issued_at": 1700000000, "ttl": 300, "exchange_steps": ["proxy-a","auth-proxy"] }
```
sara: +1 for chain. also need to make sure we don't leak PII or customer secrets in there. keep ids opaque.
raj: agree. we should canonicalize fields to `origin_id`, `origin_type`, `chain`. and teach tracing to attach `auth.explainability` tags.
maria: for Console UX, proposal: a small modal on request details called "Routing reason" that shows bullets: "original key: org_XYZ (org), exchange: svc-proxy -> auth-proxy -> runtime, final project: P123, reason: project-binding policy allowed exchange". clickable links to traces/logs.
kevin: telemetry needs new metrics: `auth.routing.path_count`, `auth.routing.fallback_reasons`, and `auth.routing.latency_impact` so we can alert if exchanges spike.
sara: and quota metrics: we need `billing.attribution.delta` that shows difference between billed project and original owner per request. helps debug bill disputes.
raj: operational concern: storing every chain in logs might increase size. propose sampling 10% for full chain and always store minimal `origin_hash` that maps to chain in the audit store for 7 days.
maria: rollout plan idea: feature-flag the header signer at ingress, enable tracing tag emission in canary region, expose Console modal in internal alpha first.
kevin: also need an API change for internal services to read `x-origin-jwt`. add helper in auth-lib: `AuthContext.fromOriginJwt()` that reconstructs chain and sets `auth.explainability` span attrs.
sara: legal: cc @legal? (not here) but we should record the opt-out for customers who don't want chain stored. add customer-level flag `suppress_auth_explainability`.
raj: ops: deploy-bot says:
@deploy-bot: deploy queued: auth-headers-signer v1 -> canary/us-west-2 at 2026-03-25T03:00Z :rocket:
maria: action items:
- raj: prototype signer + header (PR)
- kevin: add trace/span attr and metrics (PR)
- sara: UX mock for modal + billing delta panel (Figma link) and opt-out flag spec
- maria: draft runbook for customer disputes
kevin: estimate: 2 wks to prototype, 4 wks to GA if no major privacy/legal blockers.
maria: flagged for next infra sync. thanks all :thumbsup:
